title: [review] messaging.py:240: MessageReceiptsResource._recei
description: Unlike MessagesResource._inbox which trims to _max_messages, the _receipts list in MessageReceiptsResource appends receipts indefinitely (line 240) with no upper bound. On long-running nodes with many receipt acknowledgments, this could consume unbounded memory. Consider adding a similar max_receipts limit with oldest-first trimming.
